duration: As stated in the agreement or to be refined in review.
effective_date: Upon full execution by the parties unless otherwise specified.
payment_terms: To be agreed between the parties (add specifics in review if compensation applies).
purpose: I run a small event rental company and need something in writing fast with a restaurant that keeps changing what they want. First it was tables and chairs for one patio night, now they added heaters, linens, extra delivery runs, setup staff staying late, and possible weekly repeat events if turnout is good. They keep texting changes after hours and assuming it’s included. I need clear pricing for added items, deposits, damage if stuff comes back broken or missing, weather cancellations, overtime if my crew stays late, photo/video use of the setup, and when final payment is due. They also asked if they can use my inventory for another location without telling me. Need something practical, professional, not aggressive, that keeps the relationship good but stops confusion and protects both sides.
title: Agreement
